description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pink pillow is in front, with a light-colored shirt laid out on the bed. The left hand reaches in to grasp the shirt near the middle while the right hand hovers to the right, then both hands lift and spread the shirt open into a flatter rectangle (two-hand object), after which the hands fold one long edge up and smooth it down, and finally the left hand gathers and folds the right side inward while the right hand steadies the fabric (left-hand object shifting back to two-hand object).
